title: vSkipper: Translating Dynamic Layer Skipping into LLM Serving Gains
abstract: arXiv:2609.37062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic layer skipping reduces LLM computation by allowing each token to execute only a subset of the model's layers. However, existing skippers rely on specialized generation loops and do not integrate with modern serving engines. As a result, fewer executed layers do not necessarily translate into lower serving latency: FlexiDepth skips 8 of Llama-3-8B's 32 layers on average, yet its standard generation loop decodes 14.6--21.0% more slowly than the base model. We present vSkipper, a virtualization layer that makes dynamic layer skippers pluggable in serving engines while preserving continuous batching, fixed-shape batches, paged KV caching, and captured decode graphs. At each routed layer, vSkipper groups tokens by the skipper's decision and uses routed execution only when predicted to be profitable. translated_title: vSkipper：将动态层跳过转化为LLM服务收益
translated_abstract: 动态层跳过通过允许每个token仅执行模型层的一个子集来减少LLM的计算量。然而，现有的跳过器依赖专门的生成循环，无法与现代服务引擎集成。因此，执行更少的层并不一定意味着更低的服务延迟：FlexiDepth平均跳过Llama-3-8B 32层中的8层，但其标准生成循环的解码速度反而比基础模型慢14.6%—21.0%。我们提出了vSkipper，一个虚拟化层，使动态层跳过器能够即插即用地集成到服务引擎中，同时保留连续批处理、固定形状批次、分页KV缓存和捕获的解码图等特性。在每个路由层，vSkipper根据跳过器的决策对token进行分组，并且仅在预测有利可图时才使用路由执行。我们在SGLang中实现了vSkipper，并在相同提示下评估了已发布的FlexiDepth检查点与上游SGLang的表现。
tldr: vSkipper是一个虚拟化层，使动态层跳过器能够即插即用地集成到现代LLM服务引擎中，在保留连续批处理、分页KV缓存等关键特性的同时，将跳层带来的计算节省真正转化为推理延迟的降低。
